title: Pointwise convergence of all consecutive-power multiple averages under mixing
exact_target: For every invertible mixing transformation T preserving a probability measure, every integer $m>=2$ and bounded measurable $f_1,...,f_m$, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $product_{j=1}^m$ $f_j(T^{jn}x)$ converge for almost every x to $product_j$ integral $f_j$?
